The Android SDK, Mono runtime and AOT Cross bundles are recorded (maui-android-sdk-bundle-r1, maui-mono-runtime-bundle-r1, maui-mono-aot-cross-bundle-r1) with their compound SPDX expressions admitted in eng/check_provenance.py. workloadSet.rationale: Workload set 10.0.401 equals the admitted local install on every Android-relevant manifest (android 36.1.69, maui-android 10.0.20, mono toolchain and emscripten 10.0.112). Only the uninstalled iOS-family manifests differ (26.5.10318 against 10301). Set 10.0.400 has mono 10.0.111 and does not match. Set 10.0.401.1 brings maui 10.0.110 and is not used.
